text: In 1547 Spain, the Englishman Francis Barnard comes to the castle of Nicholas Medina [demanding to know how his sister Elizabeth died|trigger|digging into a mystery]. Nicholas, son of an Inquisition torturer, [saw his mother walled up alive as a boy|origin|harm done in childhood] and now fears Elizabeth was buried living too. Her harpsichord plays at night, her portrait is slashed, and [her tomb holds a body frozen mid-scream|wrong|disturbing the dead], while below waits [the torture chamber with its iron maiden|images|ropes, cages and executions].
